gloss: to make noise, to be noisy

definitions.gloss: to make noise, to be noisy
definitions.explanation: To create loud sounds or commotion, often disruptively.

definitions.gloss: to make a fuss, to cause a commotion
definitions.explanation: To create excitement or disturbance about something.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{騒|さわ}ぐ (X makes noise).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing action. {騒|さわ}いで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is being noisy.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {騒|さわ}がないで (don't make noise)
- ⟦{大騒|おおさわ}ぎ→大騒ぎ：18301_oosawagi⟧ (big commotion—noun)
- ⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ{立|た}てる→騒ぎ立てる：29386_sawagitateru⟧ (to make a big fuss)
- お⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧ (festive commotion)
- ⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧ (noise, commotion—noun form)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦うるさい→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧ (noisy—adjective)
- ⟦{騒|さわ}がしい→騒がしい：17685_sawagashii⟧ (noisy—adjective form)

REGISTER: Neutral. Can have negative connotations when referring to disruptive noise.
